findings.message: GSAP tween on "#d42-s0-dg-b0" uses motion that snaps to integer device pixels: top. Layout and text-reflow properties snap during browser layout; roundProps rounds the tween value. Slow motion or an ease-out tail then stutters under the seek-by-frame capture engine. Animate transforms (x/y/scale/opacity) instead.
findings.fixHint: replace top with the transform equivalent (y), e.g. tl.fromTo("#d42-s0-dg-b0", { x: -1300 }, { x: 0, ...yourAnimation }). Transforms interpolate sub-pixel and stay smooth at any speed.
